Lat/Long: 40.714315, -74.125097 (Approximated from premise)
Report DescriptionTHIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1415047/// THE UPDATED INFO IS AS FOLLOWS: CALLER REPORTED THAT THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE WAS DETERMINED THAT THERE WAS A PLUG IN THE CITY OF NEWARK"S SEWER LINE. THE SRP HAS BEEN UPDATED. THE CAUSE OF THE PLUG IS UNKNOWN TO THE CALLER. THE MATERIAL CONTAINED COMMINGLED INDUSTRIAL WASTE WATER FROM AT LEAST 2 FACILITIES ON THE SAME STREET WHERE THE INCIDENT OCCURRED. THE MATERIALS PAGE WAS UPDATED TO REFLECT THAT 150 GALLONS OF MATERIAL REACHED THE RIVER BUT THE TOTAL AMOUNT RELEASED IS UNKNOWN BECAUSE NOT ALL OF THE MATERIAL MADE IT TO THE WATER AND WAS STOPPED BEFORE REACHING IT. THE ORIGINAL REPORTED INFO IS AS FOLLOWS: CALLER IS REPORTING THAT A LINE TO THE POTW WAS PLUGGED AND CAUSED A BACK UP IN A MANHOLE AND OVERFLOWED THE MANHOLE. THE MATERIAL RELEASED IS INDUSTRIAL WASTE WATER AND IT WENT OUT ONTO THE GROUND AND INTO A STORM DRAIN THAT LEADS TO THE PASSAIC RIVER. THE CAUSE OF THE PLUGGED LINE IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME.
